verdict.rationale: Stripe Treasury is a financial-account product with a Dashboard, so in-product AI-generated insights are a fair question to ask of it. However, nothing in the evidence documents AI-generated insights or suggestions drawn from user data. The MCP server, llms.txt, and automatic fraud risk controls are adjacent capabilities, not in-product AI insights, so they earn no credit.

support.subject: As an AI-native user, I can get AI-generated insights and suggestions from my data inside the product
